requests: Whether the SER feeder cable can be run through the 1-1/4" conduit and remain code compliant
Whether the SER cable needs to be clamped, given that the conduit is much larger than the cable
Whether existing circuits can be relocated by running individual 14 AWG wire through the conduit and extending them with WAGO inline connectors
reason: The self-answer says the feeder had to be upsized to 1/1/1/2 SER, which implies SER is acceptable for the feeder, but it never directly says whether SER may run through the conduit. It does not address clamping at all. It does say that conductors run through the nipple must be THHN rather than unjacketed Romex wires. It does not address whether WAGO inline connectors may be used to splice the extensions.
label: Partially answered
